name: Stormpike's Request
summary: Stormpike's Request is a written commission dispatched by Mountaineer Stormpike from the cold peaks of Dun Morogh to Stormwind City. The letter petitions master armorsmith Furen Longbeard to craft a custom shield of unmatched dwarven quality.

sections.title: A Northern Commission
sections.body: While stationed far to the north in Dun Morogh, Mountaineer Stormpike requires a sturdy new shield to weather the dangers of the dwarven frontier. Rather than trusting an ordinary smith, he insists on commissioning Furen Longbeard, an armorsmith whose legendary craftsmanship he holds in the highest regard. Because Furen now resides far to the south among the humans of Stormwind's Dwarven District—lured away from Ironforge by what Stormpike assumes must be a king's ransom—the mountaineer relies on traveling adventurers to deliver his formal request across the kingdoms.

sections.title: The Stormpike Line
sections.body: Delivering the letter into the bustling Dwarven District of Stormwind places the order directly into Furen Longbeard's capable hands. As a proud and established dwarven clan known across Khaz Modan for both martial grit and substantial wealth, a Stormpike commission carries weight. Pleased to receive word and business from his ancestral northern homelands, Furen agrees to fulfill the order and set to work hammering out the mountaineer's shield.

faq.answer: It is a written order sent by Mountaineer Stormpike from Dun Morogh requesting that the master armorsmith Furen Longbeard forge him a high-quality shield.
It was penned by Mountaineer Stormpike, a dwarven sentry defending the snowy passes of Dun Morogh who deeply admires Furen Longbeard's smithing craft.

faq.q: Where does this letter need to go?
aliases: where do i take stormpikes request
faq.answer: It is addressed to Furen Longbeard, who works at his forge within the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

faq.q: Why does Stormpike hire a smith all the way in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike considers Furen's skill unmatched and refuses to settle for any other armorer, even though Furen chose to leave Ironforge to ply his trade among the humans in the south.

angles.text: The request is a testament to the reputation of master armorers, demonstrating that great dwarven smithwork commands patrons across entire kingdoms.
For dwarves, carrying the request maintains bonds of clan and craft between the mountaineers guarding Khaz Modan and craftsmen living abroad in human cities.
